# r/NBASpurs (post by hand; read the sub's self-promotion rules first)

**Title:** Where the San Antonio Spurs stand in The 644, our ranking of all 644 NBA players

**Body:**

The San Antonio Spurs in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #3 Victor Wembanyama 85.7
- #66 De'Aaron Fox 55.6
- #68 Stephon Castle 55.0
- #73 Luke Kornet 54.6
- #85 Julian Champagnie 53.6
- #114 Devin Vassell 51.3
- #120 Dylan Harper 50.3
- #122 Tobias Harris 50.1

GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
